summary: Casey Mountain lookout near Cranbrook, BC: a 1919 Forest Branch station, a 1934 fire report, a 1943 fire count, and a 2026 listing as likely standing.

facts.status_note: A 2026 guide lists it among lookouts confirmed or likely to have standing structures.
facts.design: Lookout with a cupola and painted window grid, per a 1944 letter

staffing.status: No current staffing found; last record is a 1944 letter from Ray Monesmith of Casey Mountain Lookout

events.note: Forest Branch listed a Casey Mountain Lookout among Cranbrook district improvements ($960.18). A June 1919 Creston Review item says a new lookout station had been built at Casey Mountain.
An additional $22.00 was spent on improvements at the Casey Mountain Lookout.
A. Pascuzzo was on duty at Casey Lookout on July 30, 1934.
Forest fire reported from the lookout on July 30, 1934; the fire was fought at a cost of $1,017 (Victoria Daily Colonist, March 1935, as reproduced on Canada Lookouts).
Ray Monesmith of Casey Mountain Lookout reported sixty fires in 1943, eleven of them from one thunderstorm (letter printed October 1944).
Rainlander guide lists the Casey Fire Lookout / Plumbob Mtn among lookouts confirmed or likely to have standing structures.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Canada Lookouts uses Casey Mountain for the site, and the 2026 guide uses Casey Fire Lookout / Plumbob Mtn. The story uses the Casey name and mentions the guide's label. The sources read do not confirm that both names refer to the same summit.

notes_for_editor: Status rests on the Rainlander 2026 guide's list, not on any inspection. The guide names the lookout 'Casey Fire Lookout / Plumbob Mtn'; I could not confirm it is the same summit as Casey Mountain. Facebook group posts in search results mention a 1986 replacement tower on Plumbob Mountain, but the post bodies could not be read (fetch_text and WebFetch returned only titles), so nothing from them is used. Canada Lookouts gives coordinates 49.246, -115.417 and elevation 1638 with no units stated; the firelookout.ca point (49.25112, -115.42126) is about 0.6 km away. The record's coordinates were not changed. The Firelookout.ca page renders its tower fields as N/A. No access level is recorded because no source gives one. No photos recorded.
